title: First-screen exercise
summary: The adoption effort's acceptance test: a fresh coding agent with only public guidance, served from the candidate build at a loopback host, builds the brief's themed screen in Vite, Next root app and Next src/app, and each run's record holds its transcript, interventions, decisions, check, lint, raw paint and production assertions with source identity.

extraDependencies.reason: The fixed product brief every run receives verbatim; its brand color and screen requirements are the exercise's input.
The runner's external-project mode supplies each run's production assertions.
